events.label: Douze leçons sur l’histoire
events.support: Contemporary review records Seuil 1996, 330 pages. The 2014 edition is not substituted for original publication.

relations.relationship: Integrates veterans’ organizations and commemorative practices into a social history of postwar France.
relations.evidence_note: Agulhon 1979, pp. 831–832, read: specifically discusses November 11 ceremonies, monuments and village sociability. His account of Prost’s political correction includes reservations about its extent. No uncritical consensus or whole-book reading.

relations.relationship: Makes methods, question formation and the historian’s social position explicit problems of historical knowledge.
relations.evidence_note: Voldman’s substantive 1996 review, pp. 174–175, attributes this methodological and epistemological argument to Douze leçons. The book itself remains unread; this is not an inferred connection from its title alone.
